question: Is the 29 January 2018 cloud computing circular still current?
gold_answer: Not as issued. Deadline moved to 31-03-2020 (19-06-2019); data archival and review rules added (05-07-2019); cloud empanelment ended 30-04-2021 and buying moved to GeM (23-04-2021). Latest: 23-04-2021

product.answer: The 29 January 2018 cloud computing circular is no longer current in force. The 19 June 2019 addendum extended its migration deadline to 31 March 2020 and added security audit requirements, the 5 July 2019 addendum clarified data migration and archival procedures, and the 23 April 2021 circular superseded it by ending the empanelment on 30 April 2021 and mandating all future cloud procurement through the GeM portal.
